anchors.label: Hybrid advance, Ogonob attacked, Karsemine ignites tripod gases, first compulsion continues
expected_source_text_contains: hybrid monsters continue their march toward the wall
Ogonob inside and lashes out with a tentacle
Karsemine launches a Firebolt at the tripod monster
Ephanna and Bonogo both fail to resist the effect of the meatwings
With two powerful Eldritch Blasts the monster is destroyed
Ogonob then uses Misty Step
anchors.summary: Hybrids are still advancing; one hybrid hits Ogonob in darkness; Karsemine's Firebolt massively damages and ignites a tripod; Ephanna and Bonogo remain compelled by meatwings; Ephanna kills a hybrid while resisting enough to attack; Ogonob Misty Steps toward a tripod.

anchors.label: Bonogo pins hybrid, Thrin panics, sewer monsters split, Baergrom's crossbow jams
expected_source_text_contains: Bonogo uses his Steady Aim ability
pinning the creature to the ground
Thrin tries to steady himself
giant sewer monsters split up
Baergrom readies himself
crossbow, only for it to jam
anchors.summary: Bonogo pins a hybrid with a heavy shot; Thrin panics and misses; sewer monsters split and continue toward the wall; Baergrom's crossbow jams so he switches to a short bow and hits the hybrid.

anchors.label: Tripod attacks Ogonob, sleeping tripod awakened, meatwings charm most of team
expected_source_text_contains: One of the tripod creatures lashes out at Ogonob
other tripod creature continues to be asleep
one that goes straight for the sleeping tripod
awakening the monster
wafting smell of meat
enchanting Thrin, Karsemin, Ephanna, Bonogo, Caelynn and Baergrom
anchors.summary: A tripod hits Ogonob and continues toward the wall; the other tripod is awakened by a meatwing sacrificing itself; meatwings emit an aroma that enchants most of the team, compelling them toward the monsters while preventing direct attacks.

anchors.label: Stafl tries Enemies Abound, golem reaches wall, Lysandra commands attacks and removes Caelynn charm
expected_source_text_contains: Stafl jumps up from being prone
casts Enemies Abound on the golem
golem ignores everything around it and dashes to the wall
Lysandra recharges her Commanding Shout
Lysnadra then removes the charm affecting Caelynn
Caelynn, who then uses a level 2 version of her spell Magic Missile
anchors.summary: Stafl inspires Ephanna and attempts to confuse the golem; the golem ignores it and reaches the wall; Lysandra commands Bonogo, Karsemine, and Baergrom to attack, then removes Caelynn's charm so Caelynn can damage meatwings with Magic Missile.

anchors.label: Hybrid damages wall, Karsemine kills tripod, golem traits revealed and destroyed
expected_source_text_contains: hybrid creatures finally reaches the wall
slowly chipping away the foundation
Karsemine again attacks the tripod monster with a Firebolt
burst into flames and die
learns it is immune to poison and charm, but weak to fire
whatever energy was holding the creature together finally collapses
anchors.summary: A hybrid reaches the wall and chips at the foundation; Karsemine kills a tripod with Firebolt; Hunter's Mark reveals the golem is immune to poison and charm but weak to fire; Ephanna, Bonogo, and Thrin contribute to destroying the golem.

anchors.label: Sewer monster climbs wall, sticky gel hazard, Baergrom saves Thrin and enables Bonogo kill
expected_source_text_contains: giant sewer monsters finally reaches the wall
right in the middle of Lysandra, Thrin and Caelynn
ooze out a sticky gel
Baergom uses his Bait and Switch ability
Commander’s Strike
Bonogo chooses the sewer monster attacking Ogonob
anchors.summary: One sewer monster climbs onto the wall among Lysandra, Thrin, and Caelynn; another attacks Ogonob in darkness and misses; sticky gel makes escape difficult; Baergrom uses Bait and Switch to move Thrin and Commander’s Strike to direct Bonogo, who kills the sewer monster attacking Ogonob.

anchors.label: Tripod impales Ephanna, Stafl uses Sleep and Luck, Lysandra calls final assault, sewer death poison spray
expected_source_text_contains: tripod creature turns its attention to Ephanna
launching a massive spike, impaling Ephanna
Stafl casts Sleep on the monster
Stafl uses Luck
Lysandra can see that they have the advantage
sprays poison on Baergrom, Thrin and herself
anchors.summary: A tripod impales Ephanna and pulls them toward it, disrupting their ability to pinpoint it; Stafl uses Sleep and Luck to disable the tripod; Lysandra calls for a final assault; Karsemine kills a sewer monster, spraying poison on Baergrom, Thrin, and herself.

anchors.label: Hybrid wounds Ephanna, Karsemine friendly fire then kills hybrid, coordinated attack kills last tripod
expected_source_text_contains: remaining hybrid moves in to attack Ephanna
dealing necrotic damage
hitting Ephanna instead
landing a killing blow on the monster
Bonogo readies the team
Finally Thrin finishes off the writhing creature
anchors.summary: The final hybrid hits Ephanna with necrotic damage; Karsemine accidentally shoots Ephanna, then kills the hybrid; the party coordinates attacks on the sleeping tripod, and Thrin finishes it to end the immediate battle.

anchors.label: Meat piles turn to goo and sink, party splits between watch/rest and refugee plan
expected_source_text_contains: burn as many remaining piles of meat as they can
remaining piles turn to goo and are sucked into the ground
full night upon them
Something needs to be done with the refugees from Edge
some members need a much needed rest
Ephanna, Stafl and Baergorm will stand watch
anchors.summary: After the battle, Karsemine and Ephanna attempt to burn remaining meat piles, which turn to goo and sink underground; with night fallen, the party splits: Ephanna, Stafl, and Baergrom stay at the wall for watch and short rest while the others check town and plan for the Edge refugees.

anchors.label: Caelynn calls Grobnok, reports Edge and Mireward, pending rockie-talkie bridge
expected_source_text_contains: Caelynn makes a quick call to Grobnok
tells him about both Edge and Mireward Reach
very frustrated
rockie-talkie connected with Lysandra’s
this will take some time
He will call them back the next day
anchors.summary: Caelynn calls Grobnok and reports Edge and Mireward Reach; Grobnok is frustrated at being unable to make a plan and act; she attempts to connect his rockie-talkie with Lysandra’s, but it will take time; he will call back the next day.
